from parking import fee


def test_a_short_stay_is_free():
    assert fee(20) == 0


def test_each_started_hour_costs_2():
    assert fee(150) == 6


def test_exactly_30_minutes_is_free():
    assert fee(30) == 0


def test_zero_minutes_is_free():
    assert fee(0) == 0


def test_31_minutes_costs_one_started_hour():
    assert fee(31) == 2


def test_exactly_one_hour_costs_one_hour():
    assert fee(60) == 2


def test_one_minute_past_an_hour_starts_another():
    assert fee(61) == 4
EOF
P=/private/tmp/msr104-venv/bin/python
$P -m pytest -q tests/test_parking.py 2>&1 | tail -5
cat > parking.py <<'EOF'
FREE_MINUTES = 30
RATE_PER_STARTED_HOUR = 2


def fee(minutes: int) -> int:
    if minutes <= FREE_MINUTES:
        return 0
    started_hours = -(-minutes // 60)
    return RATE_PER_STARTED_HOUR * started_hours
EOF
$P -m pytest -q tests/test_parking.py 2>&1 | tail -5
git add parking.py tests/test_parking.py; git commit -qm "Add the parking fee
